items.desc: 8 european city break ideas: 🏛️🌷✈️ 1. Florence, Italy: Tuscan city known for it’s art, architecture and history. Visit the Uffizi gallery, Ponte Vecchio and the Florence Duomo. 2. Bruges, Belgium: A medieval city famous for its cobbled streets, canals, belgian chocolates and the historic centre. 3. Colmar, France: A city in the north-east of france, dubbed ‘Little Venice’ due to its colourful houses and canals. 4. Budapest, Hungary: The capital of Hungary, visit the iconic parliament building, the Danube river, thermal baths and Buda castle 5. Salzburg, Austria: The birthplace of Mozart and setting of The Sound of Music, visit the old town, Mirabell Palace and Salzburg Cathedral  6. Sorrento, Italy: A coastal town with cliff top views, lemon groves, piazzas, bathing platforms and a historic old town. 7. Lisbon, Portugal: Portugals hilly capital, check out the Aflama district, Tram 28 and try pastel de natas. 8. Amsterdam, Netherlands: Known for its many canals, architecture, Van Goph museum and the Anne Frank House. #eurosummer #travelling #citybreaks #trending #fyp
items.title: my favourite towns and cities in europe!
